title: Venezuelan Bread Stew
description: A hearty stew made with venezuelan spices and served with warm bread. Perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew, tomato paste, venezuelan seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine, then add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add the jubilant fruit and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, topped with bread cubes.
Optional: serve with a side of crusty bread for dipping in the stew.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
